authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan sources, focusing on underetymologised and smaller sources first for greater diversity. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have unlimited time now

proposals.evidence: Turner5239 gives Nepali jiu body/life and Maithili jiu life/soul in the jīva family. Both source body attestations fit the contracted regional form; the homonymous source tongue jiu is excluded. Existing Done/East classification and broad Danuwar dialect-mapping uncertainty remain unchanged.

The long-vowel singleton and short-vowel geminate source forms belong to this bone family. Preserve the source dental diacritics and plain r; the entry’s proposed deeper connection with asthi is explicitly doubtful. Existing Done/East classification and broad Danuwar dialect-mapping uncertainty remain unchanged.
